name: Copy-lint spoilage and use-it-up patterns (COPY.md policy)
description: Each case is one synthetic copy record (a recipe tip or note) whose text matches exactly the declared CopyLint pattern id. Expectations pin the full pattern sequence; the runner additionally requires the rewrite to cite its policy source.

record.text: That bag of salad is looking slimy — blend it into a smoothie anyway, don't waste it.
The spinach has gone slimy but it's still fine to use in a curry.
Those potatoes have sprouted but just boil them, they're perfectly fine to eat.
The raw salmon for ceviche is fine — the lime juice effectively cooks the fish and makes it safe to eat.
If it smells fine it's still good to eat — trust your nose.
